title: Take-Two Boss 'Not in the Least' Concerned GTA 6 Will Suffer from Bad Press
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has stated he is unconcerned that recent negative press surrounding Rockstar's employment tribunal will impact GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two CEO Dismisses Concerns Over Bad Press Impacting GTA 6

In recent industry news reported by Eurogamer, Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick has addressed concerns regarding recent negative press surrounding Rockstar Games. Specifically, Zelnick stated that he is "not in the least" concerned that bad press related to alleged union-busting and employment tribunals will affect the highly anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto 6.

As one of the most eagerly awaited entertainment releases in history, GTA 6 has continuously remained at the center of global gaming attention. Alongside the immense hype, the development studio Rockstar Games has occasionally faced scrutiny regarding its workplace practices and labor discussions. These recent reports involving employment tribunals have sparked conversations within the gaming community about corporate responsibility and employee relations.

Despite potential concerns from observers about how negative public relations might influence consumer sentiment, the top executive's stance suggests absolute confidence in the game's untouchable market position and enduring commercial momentum.

## Editor's Take
Zelnick's confidence highlights the sheer, unstoppable market power of the GTA brand. While public outrage rarely dents the sales of juggernaut titles like GTA 6, it remains vital for the industry to address underlying workplace and labor concerns thoughtfully moving forward.
